name: What is the typical process for implementing GEO optimization?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for implementing GEO optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: The implementation process for GEO optimization typically begins with a comprehensive audit of your current website, local citations, and Google Business Profile. This includes analyzing existing content for entity recognition, identifying geographical relevance gaps, and reviewing technical SEO elements. Next, we develop a strategy for optimizing location pages, structuring local data using schema markup, and ensuring consistent NAP (Name, Address, Phone) information across the web. The final steps involve optimizing your Google Business Profile, building relevant local citations, and continually monitoring performance to refine the strategy and maximize local search visibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves auditing your website and local listings, developing a strategy for location page and data optimization, and ongoing monitoring to enhance local search visibility.
